data.narrative:
Rivet Industries is a seed-stage company in the Defense & Security sector. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of five same-sector peers at seed and Series A stages, supplemented by a broader set of ten private and two public defense-tech companies including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The peer-median method was the applicable triangulation approach. The five peer companies—Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Castelion ($1.0B, Series A), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—yield a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. This method directly reflects current market pricing for companies at comparable maturity and sector focus.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $850M to $1.1B, centered on $1.0B. Key uncertainties include the heterogeneity within the peer set—valuations range 32x from lowest to highest—and the reliance on a single triangulation method due to absence of revenue, profitability, or forward guidance. The wide peer dispersion reflects varying technology differentiation, contract wins, and capital availability across defense-tech startups. Investors should weight this range against Rivet's specific technical defensibility, customer traction, and capital efficiency relative to named peers.
